title: Bistro Floor & Dining Room Service
sources: The Professional Server: A Guide to Concept-Driven Service (Prentice Hall)
Culinary Institute of America: Remarkable Service Guidelines
ServSafe Food Handler Dining Room Safety Standards
rules: Never auction food at the table; track seat numbers (pivot points) systematically.
Serve food from the guest's left whenever structurally possible, and clear plates from the guest's right.
Critical allergens must be flagged explicitly before transmitting tickets to the kitchen.
Maintain tray center of gravity above 80% to avoid spills in high-traffic floor pathways.
assumptions: Shift takes place during peak dinner service at a 40-seat boutique bistro.
The dining room uses a 4-point pivot system with Seat 1 facing the entrance.
Tickets are transmitted via digital POS directly to kitchen line printers.

stations.name: Kitchen Pass & Heat Lamps
stations.description: Inspect completed dishes under heat lamps, garnish plates, and load serving trays.

stations.name: POS Terminal Station
stations.description: Input orders, apply allergen modifiers, fire courses, and process payments.

stations.name: Booth Table 1
stations.description: Four-top leather booth where guests dine, require water refills, and receive service.

stations.name: Side Service Station
stations.description: Store clean cutlery, restock ice water carafes, scrape dirty dishes, and stow bus tubs.

levels.title: Pivot Order & Allergy Tagging
levels.goal: Record Table 1's entree selections with the requested gluten allergy modifier and transmit the order at the POS Terminal.
levels.instruction: Walk to the POS Terminal, enter the meals for Seat 1 and Seat 2, tag the gluten-free modifier, and press Send Ticket.
customerProfiles: Seat 1: Guest with celiac disease ordering Pan-Seared Salmon.
Seat 2: Guest ordering Ribeye Steak cooked Medium-Rare.
successConditions: Seat 1 entree is set to Pan-Seared Salmon.
Gluten allergy toggle is activated for the kitchen line.
Seat 2 steak doneness is set to Medium-Rare.
Kitchen ticket transmission is toggled to true.
steps: Review diner order specifications for Table 1.
Select the correct entrees matching seat pivot points.
Toggle the gluten-free warning to avoid kitchen cross-contamination.
Set Ribeye doneness to Medium-Rare.
Send the order ticket to the kitchen pass.

levels.title: Tray Balancing & Pivot Delivery
levels.goal: Pick up plated dinners from the Kitchen Pass and deliver them to Table 1 without spills or auctioning food.
levels.instruction: Walk to Table 1, ensure tray stability is at least 85%, and deliver Seat 1's meal from the guest's left side.
customerProfiles: Table 1: Waiting for two entrees, observant of formal service etiquette.
successConditions: Tray stability is maintained between 85% and 100%.
Approach is executed from the guest's left.
Food auctioning question is switched off.
steps: Lift the heavy oval banquet tray with both hot plates.
Raise tray balance stability slider above 85%.
Approach Seat 1 from the guest's left side without reaching over diner space.
Ensure food is not auctioned off by keeping silent pivot memory.
Confirm delivery of both plates.

levels.title: Pre-Bussing & Table Maintenance
levels.goal: Clear finished plates and used silverware from Table 1, then scrape and sort ware into the Side Service Station bus tub.
levels.instruction: Walk to the Side Service Station, configure plate stacking between 2 and 4, scrape scraps, and separate silverware.
customerProfiles: Table 1: Both diners have laid cutlery in the 4:20 position signaling completion.
successConditions: Stacked plates carried is between 2 and 4.
Food scraps are scraped into the compost/trash receptacle.
Flatware is sorted separately from china.
Table crumber is used and reset confirmed.
steps: Clear empty dishware using the three-plate clearing technique.
Carry between 2 and 4 plates safely to the Side Service Station.
Scrape remaining food debris before nesting plates.
Separate knives and forks into dedicated soak cups.
Mark the table as crumbed and ready for dessert or billing.

levels.title: Check Splitting & Payment Settlement
levels.goal: Split Table 1's final tab evenly between 2 cards, apply the requested 20% gratuity, and print customer merchant copies.
levels.instruction: Walk to the POS Terminal, split the check across 2 covers, apply a 20% tip, and finalize transaction.
customerProfiles: Table 1: Couples requesting an even split across two credit cards with a 20% tip.
successConditions: Split covers slider is set to 2.
Payment type is set to Split Credit Card.
Receipt print and table closeout toggle is true.
steps: Open Table 1 ticket on the POS screen.
Divide total balance evenly across 2 diners.
Select Split Credit Card processing.
Enter exactly 20% gratuity.
Print customer receipts and close the table session.
